name: Search Issues with JQL (POST)
description: Searches for issues using JQL with enhanced search capabilities. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issue-search/#api-rest-api-3-search-jql-post)

configurable_props.name: jql
configurable_props.label: JQL Query
configurable_props.description: The JQL that defines the search. If no JQL expression is provided, all issues are returned. Note: `username` and `userkey` cannot be used as search terms due to privacy reasons. Use `accountId` instead

configurable_props.name: maxResults
configurable_props.label: Max Results
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of items to return per page

configurable_props.name: nextPageToken
configurable_props.label: Next Page Token
configurable_props.description: Token for pagination. Use the token from a previous response to get the next page of results

configurable_props.name: fields
configurable_props.label: Fields
configurable_props.description: A list of fields to return for each issue. Use it to retrieve a subset of fields. Examples: `summary,comment` or `*all,-comment`

configurable_props.name: expand
configurable_props.label: Expand
configurable_props.description: Use expand to include additional information about issues in the response

options.label: Returns field values rendered in HTML format
Returns the display name of each field
Returns the schema describing a field type
Returns all possible transitions for the issue
Returns all possible operations for the issue
Returns information about how each field can be edited
Returns a list of recent updates to an issue
Returns versioned representations of field values

configurable_props.name: properties
configurable_props.label: Properties
configurable_props.description: A list of issue property keys for issue properties to include in the results. A maximum of 5 issue property keys can be specified

configurable_props.name: fieldsByKeys
configurable_props.label: Fields By Keys
configurable_props.description: Reference fields by their key (rather than ID)

configurable_props.name: reconcileIssues
configurable_props.label: Reconcile Issues
configurable_props.description: A list of issue IDs or keys to reconcile for read-after-write consistency. This ensures that recently created or updated issues are included in the search results
